name: kafka-mcp
description: Debug Kafka from an agent: find messages, measure consumer lag, unblock consumers, compare clusters.
long_description: Connects to the Kafka clusters named in your kafka-mcp.yaml and exposes one of its endpoints over stdio. Read-only endpoints hide every tool that writes, and every write previews what it would change before it does anything. See https://denizgursoy.github.io/kafka-mcp/#configure for the configuration file.

config_file.description: Your kafka-mcp.yaml: the clusters to connect to and the endpoints to expose.
